Inquiry.title: Contact Inquiry
Inquiry.description: Message submitted by a recruiter, hiring manager, or visitor via the contact form.

subject.description: Subject or role title of the inquiry.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the message was sent.

status.description: Current processing status of the inquiry.

Endorsement.title: Professional Endorsement
Endorsement.description: Recommendation or testimonial from colleagues, mentors, or clients.

authorName.description: Name of the person providing the endorsement.

authorRole.description: Job title or relationship to Prosper (e.g. IT Supervisor, Senior Engineer, GCTU Lecturer).

organization.description: Company, bank branch, or institution (e.g. National Investment Bank, GCTU).

skillFocus.description: Key IT area commended (e.g. Hardware Troubleshooting, Systems Administration, Reliability).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the endorsement was submitted.

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Recruitment inquiries, job offers, and messages sent via the contact form.

/endorsements/{endorsementId}.description: Public peer recommendations and IT professional testimonials.
